purpose: Declare the information preserved and omitted when canonical World Map material is compressed into reader-facing analytical views. These records describe view loss; they do not replace canonical data owners.

reconstructability_scale.source-linked: The view is lossy, but the canonical source owner and identity remain available for navigation or re-query.
reconstructability_scale.partial: Some source identity remains available, but the current runtime cannot reconstruct all inputs represented by the view.
reconstructability_scale.none: The view cannot reliably lead back to the source inputs and must not be promoted as a canonical analytical view.

country-scalar.label: Country scalar shading
country-scalar.operation: one observation per country -> visual fill plus exact value text
information_loss: other variables not selected by the active scalar layer
source detail not exposed by the selected observation
country-scalar.source_path_back: active layer source_owner plus country identity

country-set.label: Country set membership
country-set.operation: one or more canonical memberships -> patterned country membership view
information_loss: attributes not represented by the active set layers
country-set.source_path_back: active layer source_owner plus runtime membership owner

active-country-relations.label: Active-country relation filter
active-country-relations.operation: typed relation graph -> bounded edges touching the active country
preserves: typed direction where the relation renderer exposes it
information_loss: relation families excluded by the current filter
edge metadata not rendered in the compact relation view
active-country-relations.source_path_back: canonical relationship graph and selected country

country-comparison.label: Pinned-country comparison
country-comparison.operation: selected country records -> bounded side-by-side comparison context
information_loss: relationships not represented by the selected comparison fields
historical variation outside the active time state
country-comparison.source_path_back: canonical country records for every pinned code

runtime_rule: The Active View adapter composes the contracts for every active analytical operation, deduplicates their loss statements, and exposes the result to presentation surfaces. A map view must never imply that a choropleth, set, relation filter or comparison contains the full canonical record.
